messages.subject: adjust width and spacing of bars in bar chart
parts:
Hi,

I've done some quick and dirty graphs in Excel:

http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/web/Excel%20version.pdf

And want to replicate this in ggplot. But the closest I come to is
this:

http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/web/ggplot%20version.pdf

using this command:

ggplot(Refraction, aes(Trait,Heri,fill=Method))+geom_bar
(stat="identity",position="dodge")+coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer()

Is it possible to equally weight each study that I've looked at within
each group on the y axis in terms of bar width (ie the Refractive
error (myopia) group is made up of data from many studies, whereas the
Refractive error (hyperopia) group only has data from one study).
Also, can we seperate the bars by a little within each group (I guess
similar to the Excel chart)?

Many thanks,

Paul

messages.author: 0f7afe3850f58838
messages.subject: Re: adjust width and spacing of bars in bar chart
parts:
See: http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/380f73e4e7d3156c
posted the same day as your question with essentially the same
question.

This width can be modified by geom_bar(width = 0.5) or whatever you
chose. I don't
believe that there is an example in the documentation or easily found
with a
search for this issue.
